attributes.action: Make "That's Not Me" - Skepta & J.M.E The National Anthem
attributes.additional_details: Skepta’s 'That’s Not Me' should be the national anthem because it celebrates raw authenticity, rejecting superficial status to embrace true self-reliance. Replacing centuries-old tradition with modern grime, it unites millions through genuine working-class culture, raw energy, and an unshakeable pride in identity. It represents the actual voice of today's youth, trading outdated royal hymns for a powerful anthem that reflects real life, resilience, and the relentless pulse of modern-day Britain.
attributes.background: We urge the UK Parliament to officially adopt Skepta's 'That's Not Me' as the new national anthem. It is time to replace outdated tradition with a powerful symbol of modern British culture, working-class pride, and authenticity. Scrap the old hymn and give the nation an anthem it actually sings.

rejection.details:
This isn’t something that the UK Government or Parliament would be able to do. The use of the present National Anthem is a matter of tradition rather than having any legal or constitutional status.

You can find more information about the history and status of the national anthem here:

https://www.royal.uk/national-anthem
